name: waf-harness
description: WAF Harness — Unified and Stable RSI Framework (TypeScript SDK, CLI, server and Web App). Fully automatic optimization: any model, any algorithm, any benchmark.

scripts.ifaces:page: pnpm gen:ifaces && node scripts/iface-page.mjs --in packages/server/src/ifaces.json --out dist-ifaces
scripts.typecheck: pnpm gen:ifaces && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/activity-bench/tsconfig.json
scripts.wafh: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs --unset=WAFH_CLI_ENTRY WAFH_HOME=~/.waf-harness/dev-data-cli WAFH_PROFILE=dev PORT=7369 -- tsx packages/cli/src/wafh.ts
scripts.desktop: pnpm -r build && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs --unset=WAFH_CLI_ENTRY WAFH_HOME=~/.waf-harness/dev-data -- pnpm --dir packages/desktop start
